program: Wingless external raw-input to representation to multi-step composition attribution
question: Was the invalid ambiguity-gated composition run limited primarily by runtime beam truncation or by transition quality?
hypothesis: Recompute the frozen ambiguity-gated pair-state propagation at deterministic runtime caps 512, 1024, and 2048 using the same learned 512-motif representation, relations, support threshold, ambiguity rule, heldout queries, and horizons. If beam truncation is the dominant cause, cap 2048 will increase minimum retained probability mass by at least 0.05 versus cap 512 and improve depth-3 pooled top-1 accuracy by at least 0.005 without degrading depth-2 pooled accuracy by more than 0.005.

supersedes_package_invalid.reason: R1 prereg commit was placed on metadata commit 1c255ca rather than the accepted scientific seal named by its own exact_parent_sha; package validation failed before authority/source/science

external_authority.execution_host_policy: GitHub-hosted compute only; host distinct from LINKDEADKB

frozen_reuse.exact_pair_relation: byte-identical top-511 exact-pair successor counts plus overflow
frozen_reuse.beam_tie_break: probability descending, then previous motif ID ascending, then current motif ID ascending

classification_rules.supported: Validity passes, cap 2048 retains at least 0.05 more mass than cap 512, improves depth-3 pooled accuracy by at least 0.005, and does not degrade depth-2 by more than 0.005; attribute the prior failure primarily to beam truncation.
classification_rules.mixed: Validity passes and larger caps improve retained mass plus at least one horizon, but the full supported attribution thresholds do not pass.
classification_rules.negative: Validity passes but larger caps do not explain the prior depth-3 error; attribute the remaining error primarily to transition quality rather than beam truncation.
classification_rules.invalid: Any authority, source, split, representation, gate, query-identity, cap, deterministic-pruning, probability, capacity, or heldout-isolation criterion fails.

validity_criteria: Exact accepted parent and North Star identities match.
R1 package-invalid and prior composition-invalid runs remain diagnostic only and are not qualification parents.
Fresh READY_RESEARCH is bound to this exact preregistration and manifest.
All learned parameters and gate decisions are training-prefix only and identical across caps.
The only experimental variable is runtime pair-state cap 512/1024/2048.
Runtime beam state is ephemeral probability mass and adds no learned or persistent capacity.
Every cap scores exactly the same heldout windows and duplicate complete probes are byte-identical.
No tokenizer, parser, external model, persistent corpus, LINKDEADKB execution, production authority, or post-result tuning occurs.
no_post_result_tuning_rule: Do not alter sources, split, representation, relations, support threshold, ambiguity rule, horizons, cap set, pruning/tie-break, controls, metrics, thresholds, classification, or authority after primary output.

successor_if_supported.intent: replace fixed beam count with a preregistered bounded retained-mass rule before the reasoning bridge

successor_if_mixed_or_negative.intent: diagnose pair-transition quality at depth before adding learned state
